title: DATA↔SEC-001: Encryption Requirements + Access/Audit Reports
description: Security provides the data-classification schema, encryption-at-rest/in-transit requirements, RBAC roles, audit-logging and PII-masking requirements, and the vulnerability-scanning remediation SLA; Data returns the classified data-asset inventory, data-flow diagrams, quarterly access-review reports, the data-security posture report, and privacy-impact / breach escalations. Grounded in DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.9 (Joint Data Security & Governance) and SECURITY_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.11.

min_tls_version.description: Minimum TLS version for all data movement.

rbac_roles.description: RBAC roles applicable to data infrastructure.

right_to_deletion_days.description: Deletion from all stores within 30 calendar days.

data_conformance.description: DATA→SEC: inventory, access review, posture, escalations.

asset_inventory_classified.description: Every data asset labeled with a classification level.

encryption_at_rest_coverage_pct.description: Assets encrypted at rest / total (%). Must be 100 for Confidential/Restricted stores.

encryption_in_transit_coverage_pct.description: Pipeline segments encrypted in transit / total (%).

privacy_impact_escalation.description: New PII / retention change / deletion request — notify within 48 hours.

notified_within_hours.description: Hours to escalation (SLA ≤ 4); honest value even if late.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Encryption baseline, data classification, and breach handling are security-baseline controls behind HG-01 (SEC release veto). ESC-SEC: agents may only propose; SEC owns binding decisions. PII triggers carry statutory deadlines (GDPR/CCPA).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER + CALENDAR (quarterly asset inventory, access-review, and posture report one week before the Joint Data Security & Governance Review; privacy-impact ≤48 h; breach ≤4 h)
confirm_conditions: asset_inventory_classified = true; Confidential/Restricted stores at 100% encryption-at-rest coverage
a confirmed data_breach was escalated within 4 hours with affected_scope; privacy-impact triggers within 48 hours
reject_conditions: any encryption standard weaker than AES-256-GCM / TLS 1.3 without an ADR + SEC sign-off (baseline violation → ESC-SEC)
a confirmed breach escalated later than 4 hours, or a privacy-impact trigger later than 48 hours (report the true number — never suppress)
a CRITICAL finding aged beyond the 7-day remediation SLA presented as compliant
counter_conditions: an approved encryption exception exists — request the compensating-control ADR reference before accepting
access-review coverage incomplete (reviewed < total) — request completion before the governance review sign-off
